The 'blur' in the background (severity 1.5) is consistent with depth-of-field in photography, though AI often uses blur to hide defects. I agree with the Router's assessment that these are minor-to-moderate issues, primarily affecting aesthetic quality rather than structural integrity of the target class (sauce).
alignment_reasoning: The Fine Grained Classifier strongly confirms the class 'chocolate sauce' (Logit 7.87 vs 4.1 for plate). All testable checkpoints regarding color, gloss, viscosity, and context are met. The image clearly depicts chocolate sauce on dessert. The score is near-perfect because the primary subject (sauce) conforms fully to the taxonomy.

The Router noted muddy texture in the cake (structural collapse severity 2.0) and smudged ice cream. While these are artifacts of generation or poor rendering, they do not catastrophically fail the image. The sauce itself remains structurally sound with good boundaries (Topology score 0.98). The artifact score is penalized for the 'muddy' food textures and background ambiguity, but not severely as the main subject is intact.
